analysis.detail: Log4Shell. This build logs user-supplied request headers through log4j-core 2.14.1 with message lookups enabled. Confirmed reachable in the request-logging filter. Remediation in progress under CR-4821.

Exploitation requires a non-default Thread Context Map lookup in the logging pattern. Our log4j2.xml uses only %d/%p/%c/%m with no ${ctx:} pattern, so the vulnerable lookup path is never evaluated. Config reviewed and pinned by CR-4821.
minimist prototype pollution. Upgraded to 1.2.6 in build 2026.09.1; the 0.0.8 copy came from a transitive devDependency now removed.
urllib3 certificate verification handling. Assessing whether the device's outbound telemetry client passes a custom CA bundle. Owner: platform-security. Target: 2026-09-12.

ReDoS in lodash.toNumber/trim variants. Our bundle is tree-shaken to lodash.get and lodash.merge only; the affected functions are not present in the shipped artifact. Verified against the production bundle manifest.
lodash.merge prototype pollution. The config loader merges an operator-supplied JSON profile, so untrusted keys reach merge(). Mitigate by upgrading to 4.17.21.
